create_smither.ponder.mechanical_smither: Three Mechanical Smithers in a row can automate any Smithing Table recipe
Using a Wrench, the Smithers' paths can be arranged
For a valid setup, all paths have to converge into one exit, forming a straight line of three
Once every Smither holds an Item, the smithing process will begin
Smithers can be arranged in any straight line of three, horizontal or vertical
Along a straight line, the Items can be placed in any order
Bent shapes do not work, the Items would just be ejected
Neither do setups with more than three Smithers
